title: Cosmological Correlators from Generating Potentials and Projective Geometry
summary: We introduce novel scalar generating potentials to compute three and four point cosmological correlators in orthogonal Grassmannian space. These correlators are obtained by applying appropriate directional derivatives on these potentials, combined with helicity-dependent minors. We emphasize that, this is not a spin-raising analog, but a much more powerful construction. The four point generating potential is associated with the geometry of a projective triangle.
